content.value_statement: Page-level HTML files can be hard to read and validate as a chapter. This skill merges them into one continuous document with preserved content and structure.
actual_capabilities: Collects chapter page HTML files in page order.
Extracts main content from page-content sections.
Builds a consolidation prompt for Claude.
Preserves tables, figures, images, captions, and semantic classes.
Defines output paths for chapter HTML and consolidation logs.
Lists quality checks for structure, completeness, and headings.
limitations: Requires valid page HTML from earlier pipeline stages.
Depends on a wrapper script outside this skill package.
AI output can require semantic and visual validation.
Does not include an automated parser or validator.

use_cases.title: Merge Course Chapters
use_cases.description: Combine many page artifacts into one readable chapter for review and publishing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Semantic Review
use_cases.description: Create a continuous document that downstream validation gates can inspect for structure and completeness.

use_cases.title: Normalize Page Artifacts
use_cases.description: Turn generated per-page HTML into a consistent chapter format during a conversion pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Consolidate One Chapter
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a standard chapter merge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to merge chapter 2 page HTML files into one continuous chapter document. Preserve all text and semantic structure.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Complex Content
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for chapters with tables and figures.
prompt_templates.prompt: Consolidate the chapter pages and verify that every table, figure, caption, list, and image remains in the final document.

prompt_templates.title: Check Heading Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request focused on semantic structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge the chapter pages, then review the heading hierarchy. Keep one chapter title and normalize section levels across continuation pages.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Gate-Ready Output
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pipeline request with logging and validation needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Consolidate the chapter, save the expected chapter artifact, and summarize page coverage, structure checks, and any unresolved content issues.

output_examples.input: Chapter 2 includes fourteen page-level HTML files with repeated headers and navigation.
output_examples.output: One continuous chapter document with a single chapter header, merged sections, preserved content, and no page breaks.

output_examples.input: A continuation page starts with duplicate navigation before a subsection.
output_examples.output: The duplicate navigation is removed while the subsection heading, paragraphs, lists, and captions remain in sequence.

output_examples.input: A chapter contains exhibits, images, and mixed heading levels across pages.
output_examples.output: The final chapter keeps exhibits and images, preserves captions, and uses a consistent heading hierarchy.

best_practices: Confirm that all expected page files exist before consolidation.
Keep original page artifacts until semantic and visual checks pass.
Review the final chapter for missing sections and duplicate content.
anti_patterns: Do not concatenate full pages without removing duplicate headers.
Do not accept AI output without checking content completeness.
Do not change wording when the source text must be preserved.

faq.question: What input does this skill expect?
faq.answer: It expects validated per-page HTML files for one chapter and basic chapter metadata.

faq.question: Does it rewrite the chapter text?
faq.answer: No. The instructions require exact wording preservation and focus on structure.

faq.question: Can it handle tables and images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the AI to preserve tables, figures, captions, and image paths.

faq.question: Does this package include the consolidation script?
faq.answer: No. It documents use of an external wrapper script from the surrounding project.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is listed as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should be checked after consolidation?
faq.answer: Check file creation, valid HTML, page coverage, heading hierarchy, and content statistics.
